name: orbit-backend
description: ORbit (SORRS V2), Team M042: API, database access and the ORbit website

scripts.db:reset: dropdb --if-exists --force orbit && createdb orbit && cd ../database && psql -d orbit -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f schema.sql -f load.sql && cd ../backend && npm run seed:users
scripts.engine:setup: cd ../engine && rm -rf .venv && python3.13 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt
scripts.test:db: dropdb --if-exists --force orbit_test && createdb orbit_test && cd ../database && psql -d orbit_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f schema.sql -f load.sql
